proposals.major_uncertainty: VAR disallowance is a replay-flagged event and cannot be treated as causal proof; no verified link between the disallowed penalty and the equalizer action; event_000635 is an interception by the opponent (2队) per annotation, which weakens the 'protagonist attack continuation' reading.
